name: Mirror Duelist
author: fastbit-ljb
description: 实验性测试模组：新增第三层敌人“镜像决斗家”，会复制角色外观、偷取并使用玩家卡牌。镜像决斗家现在拥有一个隐藏的瓦库（Whispering Earring）式自动打牌玩家，并直接走原版 CardModel.OnPlayWrapper；每个敌方回合会持续自动打牌而不受瓦库 13 张上限限制，同时保留递归保护。初始拥有10颗星星。仍可能存在兼容性问题，请勿用于重要存档。 Experimental test build: the Mirror Duelist now owns a hidden Vakuu-style synthetic player and resolves stolen cards through the vanilla CardModel.OnPlayWrapper pipeline. It continues autoplaying beyond Vakuu's 13-card limit with a recursion guard. Use at your own risk.
